verdict.rationale: Missive documents and hosts an official MCP server (mcp.missiveapp.com) that lets external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor connect and act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with chosen permissions, and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live with OAuth-gated scopes for read/write actions. This is server-side agent connectivity, not just client MCP consumption, matching the story precisely. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report of a successful external agent session beyond Missive's own changelog claims.
